values.note: DNR rate table gives one rate for the Port Crescent campground, $45 (listed in the 20/30-amp column; no separate 50-amp or full-hookup rate). Mini cabin $80, camper cabin $120, cottages and GeoDomes $128-185. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds, on top of the camping fee.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Port Crescent / campground: Modern camping 20/30 AMP rate $45, other columns '--'; reservation season April 22 - October 14) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/portcrescent ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/portcrescent (Port Crescent Modern Campground: 'There is 20- or 30-amp service available or 50-amp available, some full-hookup sites'; tags 'Full-hookup sites', 'Some campsites with 50-amp service'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 142 modern sites (three ADA sites by the toilet/shower building; two lakefront hammock-only sites, H66 and H67), plus five cottage cabins, a deluxe cottage and two GeoDomes.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/portcrescent (Port Crescent Modern Campground 'Number of sites: 142'; hammock-only sites #H66 and #H67), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sanitation station near the campground office with potable water and two lanes, for registered campers only; dishwashing station; buoyed swim area in the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/portcrescent ('accessible modern toilet and shower building', 'Vault toilet', 'The park's sanitation station is located near the campground office in the modern campground. There is potable water available and two lanes', 'unable to offer sanitation station access to non-registered campers'; campground tags 'Concession or store', 'WiFi'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/portcrescent (Port Crescent Modern Campground: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Confirmed on the DNR pages: $45 for 2026 (one rate) with the Recreation Passport in fees.note, season Apr 22 - Oct 14 (manual, unchanged), and the --AWH note (3 miles of Lake Huron/Saginaw Bay shoreline, waterfront sites; kept as written). Added 50-amp/water/sewer, 142 sites, showers/flush and vault toilets/dump/store/WiFi, reservable on midnrreservations.com. midnrreservations.com's API sits behind an Azure WAF, so no per-site lengths. Not stated for this park: max rig length, booking window/max stay (left inherited).
flags: Website is only the bare reservation home page (https://midnrreservations.com/) and the entry has no phone: the park's own page is https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/portcrescent and its phone is 989-738-8663. Also worth knowing: 'The day-use area and campground/overnight lodging options are two miles apart, each with separate entrances.'
